content.comment_body: Hello everyone, does anyone have a sequential programming example for a [product_name] PLC, similar to what is shown in the video at [url]? Which do you recommend for programming—Ladder Diagram or FBD? I prefer FBD, but haven't had much luck finding examples online. Thanks.
FBD is the way to go. Ladder Diagram doesn't offer as much flexibility for this type of programming.
I agree! I just came across a useful example here: [url]
I've completed a sample program and it's working well.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing approaches to sequential programming for a [product_name] PLC, focusing on the advantages of Function Block Diagram (FBD) over Ladder Diagram (LAD). The community favors FBD for its flexibility and shares external resources. Success was reported after creating a sample program, showing that with available tools and references, effective implementation is possible.
